falsifier_requirement.trigger: Holdout labels leak into model selection, fewer than 20 tasks/folds are scored, comparator ties or beats within uncertainty, or any OpenML task/version hash changes.

formula_requirement.formula_or_model: Select the model family and hyperparameters using only training/validation folds from a fixed manifest of logistic regression, random forest, and gradient boosting candidates, then score the heldout fold once.

incumbent_comparator_requirement.baseline_name: OpenML dummy, majority, logistic-regression, and random-forest baselines
incumbent_comparator_requirement.prediction_rule: Score preregistered DummyClassifier, majority-class, logistic-regression, and random-forest baselines on the same task folds; compare against the strongest admissible baseline.
incumbent_comparator_requirement.required_material_margin: model residual must beat comparator residual under the declared domain-local metric

next_escalation: If status is CAPABILITY_DEVELOPMENT_REQUIRED, implement the listed script/flags/model support. If evidence remains negative, preserve fail-closed science and repair the model/comparator rather than flipping PASS.
no_fake_closure_policy: This execution cannot close broad superiority unless the downstream scoring and replay artifacts pass.
pass_predicate: A governed domain scorer script/flags exist, run cleanly, and the downstream domain-scoring report plus oc_prediction_scoring_row become PASS.
repair_strategy: Implement or repair the exact domain scorer until the downstream scoring artifact passes or remains honestly fail-closed with a narrower research blocker.

residual_requirement.formula: per-task generalization residual: 1 - balanced_accuracy, with log-loss as secondary metric
residual_requirement.superiority_rule: paired residual margin over best comparator is positive after uncertainty

target_variable.extraction_rule: Test labels and final fold metrics are sealed until all candidate model outputs are written.
target_variable.name: heldout_openml_task_generalization_score
target_variable.unit: balanced accuracy error or multiclass log-loss on official holdout fold

uncertainty_requirement.metric: per-task generalization residual: 1 - balanced_accuracy, with log-loss as secondary metric
uncertainty_requirement.rule: paired bootstrap over tasks/folds plus binomial label uncertainty for accuracy

why_it_failed: The domain scorer ran, but the OC model/comparator/materiality predicates remain fail-closed.
